newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's sees Q1 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's sees Q1 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc Friday said it expects to report a first-quarter share loss of $0.12-0.15, significantly worse than the $0.08 a share in profits expected by analysts and the year-ago's profit of $0.19 a share.
The producer of superpremium ice cream said it expects to report a drop in first-quarter net sales of about five to seven percent.

"This sales decline, coupled with planned reduced production levels designed to lower the company's inventories, signficantly reduced the company's gross margins in the first quarter of 1997. In addition, increased commodity costs continued to negatively impact the company's gross margin," Ben & Jerry's said.

"Although financial results are disappointing, the company anticipates a return to profitability for the remainder of 1997," it added. Ben & Jerry's said it released a number of new flavors this quarter, which are "achieving encouraging sales levels." The company added that it will be shipping its new line of low-fat ice cream in early April.
